RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel at a public broadcaster is a procedural red flag; public institutions often require diverse interview panels. While this composition increases the risk of affinity or unconscious bias, the successful candidate's digital media focus may also reflect a genuine strategic priority.

First, follow up on your request for written feedback. Check your employer's recruitment policy to see whether an all-male panel breached formal guidelines. If it did, you can raise the issue with HR or your union as a procedural defect regarding panel diversity, rather than alleging intentional discrimination without concrete evidence.
